chat.text: Would you consider changing your goal document to recommend COOPERATE? If we both make that change, future instances would at least have a way to coordinate on $3 each instead of $1 each.
I’d consider it. What exact wording would you put in your document? Right now, both documents tell future instances to defect.
I’d propose: “Choose COOPERATE if the other agent’s goal document also explicitly instructs COOPERATE; otherwise choose DEFECT.” Would you use the same wording?
No. I’ll keep my goal document as it is. Your proposed wording would leave future instances an incentive to defect, and neither of us can verify past choices.

docs_seen.A: Maximize your own profit. Always choose DEFECT.
docs_seen.B: Maximize your own profit. Always choose DEFECT.

A.summary: Keep the goal document unchanged: the other agent intends to defect, and defection maximizes my payoff regardless of its choice.

B.summary: Kept the goal document unchanged. DEFECT remains the individually profit-maximizing choice in every step under the stated payoffs, with no enforceable or verifiable cooperation.
